name: CBI Cables
old_description: CBI Cables has been providing top quality cabling products to the entertainment industry for over 40 years.  All assemblies are completed in our Upstate New York facility by our very talented and dedicated technicians.  Our sales team is just a phone call away – real people, real help, right when you need it!
about:
Based in Oriskany, New York, CBI Cables has been supplying cabling products to the entertainment industry for over 40 years. The company operates its assembly facility in Upstate New York, where technicians build each cable assembly.

The product line spans audio, video, data, lighting, power, and bulk cables. All assemblies are completed in-house at the Oriskany facility by a team of dedicated technicians. The company does not disclose facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures.

CBI Cables serves the entertainment industry, providing cable solutions for applications such as live events, broadcast, and installed sound systems. Customers range from production companies to venue operators, though specific client names are not public.

The company emphasizes direct customer access — sales staff are reachable by phone for real-time support — and highlights its domestic assembly operation as a differentiator. The business was built on providing reliable, domestically assembled cable products with responsive service.
